subject: Partner Studio Series — pilot session proposal with Snippet Labs
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Anna Martinez <anna@snippetlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Partner Studio Series — pilot session proposal with Snippet Labs

Hi Anna,

Quick intro — I lead partner programs at Redwood Inference. We’ve been doing a small pilot of a partner-led content format we call the "Partner Studio Series": a tight 30-minute live session that combines a short customer story or use case (8–10 minutes), a focused tech demo (15 minutes) and a live Q&A (5 minutes). The idea is to make the bar for co-hosting very low while producing highly actionable content for developer and platform engineering audiences.

I’d love to pilot one with Snippet Labs in July if you’re up for it. High-level asks from our side:
- Co-host (one marketing + one engineer)
- 30–45 minute dry run the week before
- Co-branded landing page and a short blog swap (500–800 words) to promote the event
- Shared lead list (agreed-upon GDPR-friendly fields)

Attached is a one-pager with the format, timing, and a quick checklist (studio-onepager.pdf). Proposed dates we have open: July 14 or July 21 — late afternoon PT works best for our US audience. What do you think?

If it helps, I can loop in our field marketing lead (Ben Carter) and partner engineering (Karthik Iyer) to coordinate logistics.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: studio-onepager.pdf (1 page — format, audience, checklist)
From: Anna Martinez <anna@snippetlabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Rourke <liam@snippetlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Studio Series — pilot session proposal with Snippet Labs

Hi Neha —

Love the idea and congrats on the crisp format. Snippet Labs would be interested in co-hosting. Quick answers:
- We can provide a marketing lead (me) and an engineer (Liam) to present the demo.
- July 21 afternoon PT is preferable for our calendar — July 14 is tight.
- We’re happy to do the blog swap; our comms team can produce a draft and we’ll share the press kit.

Two short asks from our side: 1) audience profile and target registration numbers so we can align amplification, and 2) confirmation that we’ll be able to record and repurpose the session across channels.

I attached our press kit and a brief audience breakdown (snippet-press-kit.zip). We’ll need a simple MOU with the shared lead fields (email, company, role) and a note about lead ownership. Happy for you to loop in your ops folks.

Thanks — excited to run this with you.
Anna Martinez
Head of Growth | Snippet Labs
anna@snippetlabs.com

Hi Anna — great, July 21 works for us. Thanks for the press kit — that’ll help our comms team shape messaging.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Audience: target is platform engineers and developer leads at midmarket+/scale-ups. Goal is 150–200 registrants with 60–80 live attendees for a pilot. We’ll split amplification (Snippet Labs does 40%, Redwood does 60%) and share a small paid social budget if you want to top up.
- Recording & repurpose: yes, we record and both sides can reuse the video. We’ll include a short permission clause in the MOU.

Logistics / next steps I propose:
1) Draft a short MOU (1 page) capturing lead fields, recording permissions, and simple cost-share for paid amplification — I’ll draft and circulate by EOD.
2) Ben, can you own the landing page and registration flow?
3) Karthik, can you and Marcus Lin coordinate a minimal reproducible demo environment (container + test data) we can spin up for the live session? Marcus has done similar with other partners.
4) Schedule a 30–45 minute dry run with all presenters the week of July 12.

I’ve attached a quick tech checklist for demo readiness (redwood-tech-checklist.md).

Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-tech-checklist.md
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Anna Martinez <anna@snippetlabs.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam@snippetlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Studio Series — pilot session proposal with Snippet Labs

Thanks Neha — looping Marcus who will help with the demo. A few quick technical notes so we don’t surprise the presenter on the day:
- Recommend a containerized demo that runs on a single GPU (we can provide access to a short-lived dev instance in Redwood Dedicated for rehearsals).
- Keep the live demo scope to a single, repeatable flow (ingest sample file -> model inference -> results visualization). Avoid multi-model switching in the live demo.
- We’ll prepare a failover recording/video clip if the live demo runs into latency or infra flakiness.

Marcus: can you prepare a minimal docker image and a short runbook (commands + env vars) by July 7? I’ll coordinate the test instance and network access.

Ben: once we have confirmed co-brand assets from Anna, can you spin up the landing page? We’ll provide a short JSON payload with utm/source tags for campaign tracking.

Happy to sync Tuesday morning (July 6) for a quick technical sync if needed.

—
Karthik Iyer
Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
